parts.tooltip: fmap f :: T a ⟶ T (F b) — from Functor T. Applies f to every element and keeps the shape of the structure; each element is now an effect waiting to be combined.

sequence :: T (F b) ⟶ F (T b) — needs Applicative F. Runs the effects left to right and rebuilds the structure inside a single outer F: Maybe fails on any Nothing, List builds all combinations, IO runs the actions in order.

ports.tooltip: f : a ⟶ F b — effectful mapper applied to each element
T a — traversable structure containing elements of type a
F (T b) — effect on the outside, rebuilt structure on the inside
